exercise_solutions.sql_query: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID] IN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] FROM [Tabelle2]);
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2], (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID]) AS [NeuerName1] FROM [Tabelle1];
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]);

SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2], [Subquery1].[NeuerName1] FROM [Tabelle1] JOIN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID], SUM([Tabelle2].[Spalte1]) AS [NeuerName1] FROM [Tabelle2] GROUP BY [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID]) AS [Subquery1] ON [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Subquery1].[Tabelle1 ID];
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID] NOT IN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Spalte2] = [String]);
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]) > [Int];
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID]) AS [Name] FROM [Tabelle1];
SELECT * FROM (SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > [Int]) AS [TempTabelle] WHERE [TempTabelle].[Spalte2] LIKE '[Buchstabe]%';
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > ALL (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Spalte2] = [String]);
SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]);

SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > (SELECT AVG([Tabelle2].[Spalte1]) FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]);
